title: geranium tricolor
intro: Geranium tricolor, commonly known as the 'Dainty Sally' or 'Hardy Geranium', is a perennial plant species belonging to the Geraniaceae family. This plant is valued for its vibrant flowers and potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and alleviating stress. The therapeutic actions of Geranium tricolor are attributed to its calming and sedative properties, which may help to soothe anxiety and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Geranium tricolor include geraniol, linalool, and other flavonoids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
